description: The short Heritage escape spelling `op` inside an EXECUTED `map` body reports the same canonical `params` `{ keyword: "return", form: "map" }` as `output` and as Core `return` (issue #741) — byte-identical to the Core twin `tests/conformance/core-language/comprehensions/comprehension-return-in-comprehension` (`:out = map n in [1] [ return :n ]`) in `code`, `params`, `stage` and `severity`. Together with its `output` sibling this pins every Heritage spelling of the second runtime `keyword` site: the defective param varied WITH the spelling, so each spelling needs its own assertion. `source_span` covers the `op :n` escape statement (5 columns against the 9 of `output :n`), so the span still follows the surface spelling while the param does not.
